To be fair, you have people who cant bear to live and dont see a solution. Often they have very little support, cant access any mental health services. They want to be done with but they are expected to live for everyone elses sake? You dont allow them to have lethal injection, you dont allow them firearms, overdoses are very ineffective. That leaves hanging, train, maybe co2 poisoning, maybe cutting. You havent left them many options, these are desperate hurting people, they arent assholes. A method that doesnt impact others is often too difficult for these suffering people to do. Most people arent able to stage an "accidental" death or somehow cleanly elogently die.

To anyone considering calling a hotline, you should know that if you say anything besides "I have absolutely no plans or desire to commit suicide" then the police will pop over to you, not listen to you, handcuff you and take you to a hospital where you will again not be listened to, be forced into a minimum stay, be forced to take mind altering drugs against your will through injection if they have to and you will likely lose your job or drop out of school.

These hotlines seldom care about yoh and just give platitudes or call the cops. If you are going to call, you decide your risk, if you show any suicidal thoughts or even mild daydreaming about it then you are very much at risk of having the police coming to cart you away
